Question:
Consider the function

\[f(x) = |\lfloor x \rfloor| - |\lfloor 1 - x \rfloor|\]

Its graph is symmetric about which of the following? (Here \(\lfloor x \rfloor\) is the greatest integer not exceeding \(x.\))
